title: ScopeProposed
description: The scoper proposed which repos a run touches, with its reasons, confidence and evidence, or that a new repo is needed (ADR 0018). Topic hotl.run; subject and key: the run id. Producer: Orchestrator. Main consumers: Portal, review service (architect brief if a new repo or protected boundary).

next.description: What the run does with the proposal: confirm it (existing repos only, high confidence, no protected boundary); ask the developer to confirm or correct it (low confidence); or ask the architect (a new repo or a protected boundary).

reasons.description: Why the proposal goes to a person, one reason per line.
